price_db.description: Path to the price database file used for commodity valuation.

init_file.description: Path to an alternative init file to load before the main journal.

date_format.description: Format string for displaying dates in reports (strftime syntax).

input_date_format.description: Format string expected for dates in journal entries.

default_commodity.description: Default commodity to assume if none is specified in postings.

options.description: List of command-line options to apply globally for all reports in this init file.

unrealized_gains_account.description: Account name used for unrealized gains in balance reports.

unrealized_losses_account.description: Account name used for unrealized losses in balance reports.

journal_file.description: Primary journal data file to load. Can be overridden by -f flag.
